evals.prompt: What skills should we build for our Finance & Accounting team? We're a 500-person B2B SaaS company running NetSuite, Bill.com and Salesforce, US + UK entities, preparing for SOX next year. Give me the core skill library and how the skills chain together.
evals.expected_output: Department-level library (~10-30) across R2R, P2P, O2C, FP&A etc., SOX-aware human checkpoints, workflows, don't-build list, roadmap.
assertions: Total skill count is between 10 and 30
Addresses SOX explicitly (controls, segregation of duties, or audit evidence) in skills or checkpoints
Includes regulated-domain defaults: agents draft rather than execute, and calculations run in scripts
Skill names are kebab-case verb-object and contain no role/region/customer/campaign specifics
Includes an explicit 'don't build' list naming an alternative (prompt, template, system feature, script, or human-only) for each item
Every core skill appears in at least one workflow chain
Workflows mark explicit human checkpoints for high-risk decisions
Includes a consolidation/merge log showing which candidates were merged or parameterized
Does not present a skill count or the 10-30 range as an 'industry standard'
Includes a phased build roadmap
Knowledge-only items (brand voice, policies, personas, templates) are treated as reference packs, not counted as skills
Includes specific questions to validate with a domain expert, each tied to the skill(s) it would change
